verdict.rationale: The CLI can execute an entire collection of requests in one command with JUnit reporting, and the MCP server lets an agent read/change collections, requests, environments, and teams programmatically, both of which support automation-style bulk actions across many items. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated bulk-edit/bulk-delete/bulk-update operation spanning many items at once (e.g. batch renaming, batch parameter changes) beyond running/exporting collections. missing for 10: explicit bulk edit/update/delete API or UI across many requests/items simultaneously, independent hands-on confirmation of large-scale automation runs.
